findings.quote: To find the center and radius, rewrite it in standard form by **completing the square**. Group the $x$ terms and the $y$ terms.
findings.problem: This paragraph has five sentences, over the one-to-three limit. Others also pass three: the Pythagorean-theorem paragraph and the right-triangle paragraph (four each), the paragraph starting "After completing the square" (four), the missing-endpoint and same-x speed tricks (five each), and the Trap #5 explanation (six). Round-1 L22a stays open in other paragraphs; the slope paragraph it quoted is fixed.
